subject: Aria Gomez — comp exception request and signoff for offer
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate: Aria Gomez — comp band recommendation + next steps

Team,

Quick context: Aria Gomez (SWE, backend infra) finished on-site last week — interview feedback is very strong across system design and production experience. Hiring manager (Maya) is recommending Level IC4 (senior engineer) and wants to move to offer. Below is the proposed structure: 

- Base: $170,000
- Target OTE / variable: not applicable (individual contributor)
- Sign-on: $20,000 (one-time)
- Equity: 0.35% over 4 years (1 year cliff)
- Location: SF Bay Area (remote-flex)

This base is ~12% above the published band for IC4 in SF. I attached the comp worksheet and a draft offer pdf. Requesting:
1) Compensation exception approval (greater than band)
2) Finalize any tweaks on sign-on/equity before we extend verbally

Timeline preference: candidate hopes to get a firm offer by end of next week.

Please advise if we can approve an exception or if we should adjust to stay within band.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Hiring Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate: Aria Gomez — comp band recommendation + next steps

Thanks, Maya — quick read through the worksheet. A couple notes: 

- The base at $170k is outside the published IC4 SF band (midpoint $152k, top $155k). That puts us ~10-12% over top of band, which requires Director-level approval per comp policy.
- Sign-on at $20k is within guideline for rare exceptions but combined with base + equity it pushes total package cost higher than typical.

I've attached my annotated worksheet. If we proceed with the current structure we should:
- Get Marcus (Director of Eng) signoff for the base increase
- Consider reducing sign-on to $15k or slightly lowering equity to align economics

Flagging finance for a quick sanity check on budget impact.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate: Aria Gomez — comp band recommendation + next steps

Jonas / team — FYI from HR comp policy: hiring manager can approve up to +10% over band for critical hires. Anything beyond that requires Director approval. Given the feedback and the competitive market for infra talent, +12% is reasonable but we should explicitly document the rationale in the comp packet.

Suggested path:
- Marcus signs off (director) on base exception (+12%)
- Marissa finalizes sign-on/equity trade-offs (reduce sign-on to $15k if needed)
- We prepare the DocuSign package once Marcus replies OK

Also adding the candidate's preferred start date (mid-July) to the offer worksheet.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Requesting director signoff: Aria Gomez (IC4) — exception to band

Marcus — quick note to request your approval on an exception for Aria Gomez. Below is the recommended offer we plan to extend verbally pending your signoff: 

- Base: $170,000 (IC4 band top is $155k) — +12% over top of band
- Sign-on: $20,000 (we can adjust to $15k if preferred)
- Equity: 0.35% (4y)
- Target start date: 2026-07-12

Rationale:
- Stellar systems design + production runbook experience — specifically shipped low-latency caching and KV improvements at scale (see interview notes attached).
- Candidate has competing offers from two startups and indicated comp is the deciding factor.
- Time-to-hire: we need to move quickly to secure acceptance.

If you approve, I'll ask Marissa to finalize the DocuSign package and Lauren will prepare the comp justification doc for records.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-05-13T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting director signoff: Aria Gomez (IC4) — exception to band

Thanks for the context, Jonas. I reviewed the interview notes and the comp worksheet. I'm comfortable approving the exception with a small economics adjustment to protect budget. Approval details:

- Approved base: $170,000 (exception granted)
- Sign-on: approve $15,000 (please update DocuSign draft)
- Equity: approve 0.35%

Please update the draft offer (reduce sign-on to $15k) and proceed with verbal offer today. Marissa, please prepare the final comp justification memo and attach to the candidate's file. Lauren, please file the exception in Workday/comp-tracking.

Good hire — expedited approval granted.

Marcus Lin
Director, Serving Runtime Engineering
